prompts.bog: Redraw image 1 (biome tree) to match image 2 (the actual base oak tree) as a production game sprite. Image 1 is the edit target/species reference, image 2 is the authoritative pixel-art STYLE AND CANVAS reference. Output ONE tree only, on a logical 48x64 pixel canvas just like image 2. If tool output requires a larger raster, use a faithful integer nearest-neighbor enlargement of a genuine 48x64 design with LARGE clear square pixel clusters, never high-res painted pseudo-pixels. Recompose and redraw for this small canvas, do not simply shrink all the fine original branches. Match base tree's natural chunky foliage clusters, sturdy textured ochre bark, visible roots, upper-left highlights, clean stepped dark olive-brown one-pixel outline. Preserve rich organic detail through deliberate readable pixel clusters: three flat shades per material (base highlight shadow), no gradients, no antialiasing. Full tree centered, crown near top, roots near bottom, 1-2 logical pixel transparent margins. Truly transparent background, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no grass platform, no detached specks, no text, no grid. The output will be packaged in Aseprite with one solid color per layer. Biome design: A gnarled wet bog tree, thick twisting dark-brown trunk, broad low mossy olive crown organized into 5-7 substantial rounded foliage masses similar to the base oak; several clear hanging moss strands, readable branch gaps, tangled roots. Moss/foliage palette #738344 base #A5AD62 highlight #485733 shadow; bark #82653F base #B19358 highlight #51462F shadow; outline #343727.
